audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p6: 50 Qs in one batch across three topics (Medicine 26, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Psychiatry 11), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3 to L5 tier, following the p3, p4 and p5 precedent, because the closed legacy L1 and L2 inventory makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.4 per cent L3, 44.4 per cent L4 and 6.1 to 6.2 per cent L5, so L5 again sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated; the greedy per-question walk produced 27 L3 and 23 L4 and zero L1 or L2. Because all four topics sat within 0.05 percentage points of each other on every tier, the raw argmax was unstable and drifted arbitrarily, so near-ties within 0.1 percentage points were broken toward the topic with the lower total, which is what the standing module-balance directive in Section 2 of the remote agent context calls for. Paediatrics was therefore not drawn on this run: it entered as the largest module at 1405 and the run brings Medicine, Obstetrics and Gynaecology and Psychiatry from 1352, 1365 and 1367 to a level 1378 each. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D11 E9; worst option length parity 1.24 across all 50; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option and no follow local guidelines non-options; every tag is drawn from the existing vocabulary except occupational, which is new and earns its place on four questions. Duplicate screening this run went through three rounds: an initial keyword sweep missed spelling and phrasing variants, and a combined subtopic_detail plus correct-answer similarity scan against all 5489 existing questions then caught seven genuine near-duplicates that were replaced outright (missed combined oral contraceptive pills, secondary postpartum haemorrhage with an open os, adenomyosis in heavy menstrual bleeding, herpes zoster antiviral timing, stress urinary incontinence first line management, empirical ceftazidime for tropical sepsis, and reduced foetal movements). All 50 finish at or below 0.55 on that combined metric.
